chunks: And from him, from Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from Safwan, from Abd al-Rahman ibn al-Hajjaj, who said:

I asked Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) about the man who plays with his wife in the month of Ramadan until he ejaculates. He said: 'Upon him is the expiation like that of the one who has intercourse.'

key_terms.يَعْبَثُ: plays or engages in sexual foreplay

ai.seo_question: What is the expiation for ejaculation during Ramadan without full intercourse?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* clarifies that pre-coital sexual play leading to ejaculation incurs the same major expiation (*kaffarah*) as full intercourse, a ruling derived from the principle of *ittiba'* (following the precedent) in Shia jurisprudence. It highlights the scholarly consensus that the specific act of intercourse is not strictly required for the penalty, but rather the occurrence of ejaculation during the daylight hours of Ramadan. This ruling underscores the gravity of breaking the fast through sexual pleasure, linking physical acts directly to spiritual accountability.
